# Evil Corp

We build workflow tooling for mid-market operations teams. Our platform handles
approvals, vendor records and monthly reporting for finance and operations
leaders across North America.

## What we do

Evil Corp replaces manual spreadsheet handoffs with a single shared workspace.
Teams of ten to one hundred people use us to cut the time spent chasing
approvals and reconciling records at month end.
